bio: Hi everyone! Welcome to Harvard! I am from Chicago and consider myself to be a proud Midwesterner at heart. I have been in Massachusetts on and off since college and over time have become a fan of all things New England, namely, the beach, hiking, fall weather, rowing, the Patriots, and the Red Sox. I love to cook and explore the amazing culinary scene in Boston/Cambridge/Somerville. When I am not enjoying all of New England's wonderful offerings, I work as the Senior Director, Strategic Communications and Initiatives, Community and Campus Life in the Office of the President. This is my tenth year as a proctor and I am looking forward to meeting all of you! Community Yards Ivy Yard Area Proctors Role Proctors
